The '''crab spider''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Spider/Legends|spider]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Despayre]],<ref name="DS" /> located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> Inside the shack of [[Celot Ratua Dil]], a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] living at [[Slashtown]] Prison Colony on Despayre, there was a crab spider as large as Dil's [[Limb/Legends|hand]] that nestled in one of the upper corners near his roof. All the crab spiders on Despayre perished with the [[Destruction of Despayre|destruction]] of the planet by the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] that occurred in<ref name="DS" /> [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Time">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' notes that the portion of [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']] in which the [[Destruction of Despayre]] happens is in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The crab spider was created by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] in their novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']], released in [[2007]].<ref name="DS" />
